sloka: सकामा भव कैकेयि हतो अयम् कुल नन्दनः ।कुलम् उत्सादितम् सर्वम् त्वया कलह शीलया ।। ६-३२-४।।
transliteration: sakāmā bhava kaikeyi hato ayam kula nandanaḥ ।kulam utsāditam sarvam tvayā kalaha śīlayā ।। 6-32-4।।

translations.english: "O Kaikeyi! Your desire is fulfilled with the killing of the delight of the race. You, who are given to creating quarrel have ruined the race."
